# StudyZone - Class 4 Maths Practice
> Free interactive maths practice for Class 4 students (ages 9-10)

StudyZone is a free web application for Class 4 students
to practice mathematics. It supports CBSE, ICSE and IGCSE
curricula with 22 topics across 3 difficulty levels.
No login, no subscription, no ads, no student data collected.

## Features
- 22 maths topics including fractions, division, geometry,
  word problems, data handling and reasoning
- 3 difficulty levels: Easy, Medium, Hard
- Instant feedback with step-by-step working
- Printable worksheet generator with a separate teacher answer key
- Mock exam generator
- PDF session report export
- No login required
- Works on mobile, tablet and desktop
- Dark mode support
- Installable as a PWA

## Curricula Supported
- CBSE Class 4 Mathematics
- ICSE Class 4 Mathematics
- IGCSE Cambridge Primary Stage 4 Mathematics

## Target Audience
- Class 4 students aged 9-10 years
- Parents of Class 4 students
- Primary school teachers

## Key Pages
- https://studyzone.co.in/ - interactive practice quiz
- https://studyzone.co.in/topics - index of all 22 topic guides
- https://studyzone.co.in/teachers - worksheets and lesson ideas for teachers
- https://studyzone.co.in/about - who built StudyZone and why
- https://studyzone.co.in/privacy - privacy policy
